id: validation-Deployment Synchronization with Instance-Invariant Storage Code-case-2

pointer.content:
Test Case 2: Kubernetes Deployment Uses Correct Image

Input: Check devbob deployment in devbob namespace

Expected Output:
{
  "deploymentExists": true,
  "imageTag": "devbob:1.0.64",
  "upToDate": true
}

Validation Logic:
- Run: kubectl get deployment devbob -n devbob -o json
- Extract spec.template.spec.containers[0].image
- Verify deployment exists
- Verify image tag matches devbob:1.0.64
- Check status.updatedReplicas > 0

Pass Criteria:
- Deployment exists in devbob namespace
- Deployment spec references devbob:1.0.64
- Deployment is up-to-date (updatedReplicas > 0)
